'''Jalen Williams''' (born April 14, 2001) is an American [[basketball]] player. He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Santa Clara Broncos men's basketball|Santa Clara Broncos]].

==High school career==
Williams played basketball for [[Perry High School (Gilbert, Arizona)|Perry High School]] in [[Gilbert, Arizona]] .<ref>{{Cite web |last=News |first=Grant Greabell/Cronkite |date=2022-02-14 |title=Jalen Williams receiving NBA buzz amid breakout basketball season |url=https://cronkitenews.azpbs.org/2022/02/14/jalen-williams-receiving-nba-buzz-breakout-basketball-season/ |access-date=2022-05-07 |website=Cronkite News - Arizona PBS |language=en-US}}</ref>  Williams grew 8 inches from his sophomore to senior year of high school .<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |title=Jalen Williams |url=https://www.santaclarabroncos.com/sports/m-baskbl/2019-20/bios/williams_jalen_84ws |access-date=2022-05-07 |website=Santa Clara |language=en}}</ref> Williams committed to played college basketball for  [[Santa Clara Broncos|Santa Clara]] in 2018 .<ref>{{Cite journal |date=2018-11-14 |title=Men's Basketball Signs Two Guards for 2019-20 |url=https://www.santaclarabroncos.com/sports/m-baskbl/2018-19/releases/20181114poubq9 |language=en}}</ref>

==College career==
As a freshman at Santa Clara, Williams averaged 8 points, 3 rebounds, 2 assists and 1 steal .<ref name=":0" /> As a sophomore Santa Clara faced injuries and covid issues Williams took a step forward averaging 12 points and 4 rebounds as a result was a WCC All-Conference Honorable Mention  .<ref name=":0" /> Williams junior year he was named First-team All-[[West Coast Conference|WCC]] (2022) and to the NABC All-District (9) Second Team he averaged 18 points, 4.4 rebounds and 4.2 assists per game .<ref>{{Cite web |title=Jalen Williams Player Profile, Santa Clara, NCAA Stats, AAU Stats, Game Logs, Bests, Awards - RealGM |url=https://basketball.realgm.com/player/Jalen-Williams/Summary/135764 |access-date=2022-05-07 |website=basketball.realgm.com}}</ref> On April 28, 2022, William announced his decision to declare for the [[2022 NBA draft]] .<ref>{{Cite web |title=Santa Clara Star Jalen Williams Declares for the NBA Draft |url=https://www.thesantaclara.org/scusounds/santa-claras-jalen-williams-declares-for-the-nba-draft |access-date=2022-05-07 |website=The Santa Clara |language=en-US}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=2022-03-31 |title=Santa Clara's Jalen Williams testing NBA draft waters |url=https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/33624374/santa-clara-guard-jalen-williams-entering-nba-draft-retain-eligibility |access-date=2022-05-08 |website=ESPN.com |language=en}}</ref>

==Personal life==
Williams family moved to Arizona when he was 7 years old .<ref name=":0" />

Williams had a 8-inch growth spurt from his sophomore to senior year of high school .<ref name=":0" />
